questions.en: What is the name of the Gaelic harvest festival associated with pagan customs and celebrations?

timeline.labelEn: The Old Irish glossary Sanas Cormaic (c. 900) explains the origins of the Lughnasadh festival
timeline.labelDe: Das altirische Glossar Sanas Cormaic (um 900) erklärt den Ursprung des Festes Lughnasadh

questions.notes: Celebrated on 1 August at the start of the harvest; also spelled Lughnasa / Lúnasa, anglicised Lammas.
